verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own rule-based automations that run without user involvement: automatic error assignment rules route errors to teams or collaborators by criteria such as file path, and integrations automatically create PagerDuty incidents or fire webhooks when errors arrive. These automations are narrow, fixed-purpose triage and alerting rules rather than a general, user-configurable background automation or agentic workflow system. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation/workflow builder, scheduled or agent-driven background tasks, depth of documentation on rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
